notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
We have updated Hexia, although many things are "hidden".

There is now an auto-save, the management of the Hexin has been adjusted to avoid being stuck halfway through the game.
We also fixed bugs that caused slowdowns during game progress.

See you soon!

notes.title: Version 1.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243517/484077d9c1228dac05951b32b5714d682429f627.png[/img]

[h2]Hexia comes out of early access to land the full version[/h2]

It's been 2 years and 6 months, that's how long Hexia has been in development. Maybe even a little longer if we count the initial drafts as well. It has been an incredible period in which so much has changed. We have faced difficulties and obstacles, just as we have been privileged to experience moments full of pride and satisfaction, as this one is.
All these experiences have matured us as professionals, and allowed us to make our team what it is now. The video game market and world is no longer just a distant dream for us now, we are in it, and we will continue to navigate this vast ocean of opportunity, doing everything we can to make our experiences worthwhile, and turn them into quality products.
The sun has risen for the new version of Hexia: a beginning and a conclusion intersected in a single thread, full of meaning.

Always forward like this, toward new horizons!


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[i]Hexia v1.0.0[/i]

[list]
[*] Resource pool in tiles has been significantly increased
[*] Buildings no longer only cost Hexin but also have a cost in resources
[*] All buildings have been changed
[*] The story is now complete and fully available
[*] Resource values at game start have changed
[*] The AP indicator now has textual wording for easier reading
[*] Removed the limit on turn progress. Now you can move forward freely
[*] The transition between the game and a new story chapter is now no longer direct but has a fade effect
[*] A new game mode is unlocked upon completing the story
[*] Added tooltips that more easily indicate the information of the main actions
[*] Added the first 15 achievements
[*] Unlocked the "Challenges" feature
[*] Fixed all events and their respective bonuses/malus that are applied based on the choices made
[*] Fixed some problems related to the use of the gamepad. The use of mouse and keyboard is still recommended
[*] Fixed tile information issues
[*] Changed the save system
[*] Fixed several bugs to make the game more stable
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Keep following us[/h3]
If you want to keep up to date on Hexia and our future projects, we recommend follow us here:
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://twitter.com/BlackMStudio]Twitter[/url][/b]

[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.3
notes.notes:
Here we are with a new version of Hexia in which we have focused on some strategic and optimization aspects.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to view the resources available for each tile on the map
[*] Added the ability to view non-operational buildings on the map
[*] Added the ability to view on the map which building has an active trade route
[*] Now when a tile's resources are depleted, building on it is automatically disabled
[*] If a trade route was active on a building, once inoperative the trade route is also interrupted
[*] Workers can now be matched to buildings only if the tile still has enough resources
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't remove the instability indicator on a tile once the temple on it was successfully activated
[*] Fixed a bug that in some cases did not make the construction of a structure not complete correctly, even though it had reached the correct turns
[*] Added more info for tile effects and more
[*] Initial implementation of the Achievements system (will be completed by version 1.0.0)
[*] Minor fixes and further optimization for Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.2
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback on Discord and Reddit we are further improving and fixing Hexia. Here we are with a new version!

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [Bug fix] - The Escape key brings up the pause menu, but doesn't close it again
[*] [Bug fix] - Destroying buildings and rebuilding them does not correctly count the number that is displayed in the name, causing confusion especially in trade routes
[*] [Bug fix] - When loading a game, the tile is not automatically selected
[*] [Bug fix] - Trade route on collapsed building show on in map and doesn't show on the 'manage trade routes' UI
[*] [Bug fix] - After a tile collapses, the worker isn't available to be assigned to a new building, even though their cottage now shows them as being 'free'
[*] The tutorials have been fixed: now the images are displayed correctly and a bug that affected the input system has been fixed
[*] Further improvements for the Steam Deck
[*] The instability of a tile is now also visible graphically in the map
[*] There is more life in the map: now you will see the workers doing their job, or waiting near their house
[*] Changes to the event system, still not impactful but which allow us to work on a series of changes that will be implemented by the next patches
[*] [New Feature] - Kingdom information is now available from the appropriate action. The information displayed will be expanded with each update
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.1
notes.notes:
Here we are with the first of a series of updates that improve Hexia, mainly following the feedback that we have received in recent days. The changes have been shared on our Discord server, so if you want to actively participate in the next updates join us too.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "Night Mode"
[*] Camera rotation is now based on tile pivot
[*] Camera zoom is faster
[*] Improved gamepad usage. During the next updates we will keep our focus on this part, in order to make Hexia fully playable on Steam Deck
[*] It is no longer possible to deselect a tile, so you will no longer have the problems with the expand action or sudden loss of selection as before
[*] Implementation of the tutorial system; it will be expanded with as much information as possible with each future update
[*] Removed the Depth of Field effect and mitigated the blur effect
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't allow modals to be closed correctly if the ESC key on the keyboard was used, making the entire game interface unusable
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0
notes.notes:
As previously anticipated, Hexia is finally updated to [b]version 0.9.0[/b]!
This is the first step towards the release of 1.0.0, a version that will close the early access cycle and make Hexia the complete game we worked so hard on.

For all those who have already purchased Hexia we hope you enjoy the update and immerse them in the world we have built.
We remind you that you can join our server [b][url=https://discord.gg/FVTACN3s79]Discord[/url][/b] to give us your feedback and report anything you deem useful, for us it would be a huge help.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Unreal Engine updated to [b]version 5.1[/b]
[*] The [b]graphic assets[/b] of the project have been completely updated and optimized
[*] The system that manages the [b]camera[/b] and its [b]movements[/b] has been totally revised and expanded
[*] We have started implementing logic to manage the use of the [b]gamepad[/b]; currently you still need a mouse and keyboard but with the next update we plan to enable their use at 100%
[*] The [b]save system[/b] has been totally changed. Old saves will no longer be managed
[*] The [b]audio compartment[/b] has been updated
[*] [b]All the gameplay has been modified[/b]: we have revised all the logic in order to make Hexia more satisfying and give it a new lifeblood
[*] Implemented the [b]turn-based system[/b] which replaces the previous real-time one; now the game will allow you to carry out a certain number of actions for each turn, it is up to the player to decide what is best to do
[*] The [b]notification system[/b] has been improved and made more functional than before. Now on some actions a confirmation will be requested and situations that are happening on the game map will be notified
[*] [b]The map is no longer structured with hexagonal tiles[/b]: we switched to square tiles in favor of the graphic update and new game mechanics [u][i](no, Hexia is not a name which derives from the hexagonal shape of the map)[/i][/u]
[*] Tiles now have a [b]stability[/b] or [b]instability[/b] status. Depending on what happens the tile can stay or fall in the clouds
[*] Each tile can apply a random [b]positive[/b] or [b]negative[/b] effect that will affect the construction done on it
[*] Tiles can be [b]renamed as you like[/b]; initially a random name is generated by the system
[*] Each tile has its own [b]infobox that provides details in a more visible and precise way[/b] than the previous contextual tooltips
[*][b]Resources[/b] have been added to the existing Hexin and Favor: [b]Wood[/b], [b]Rock[/b], [b]Food[/b] and [b ]Workers[/b]
[*] Added the [b]Trade Routes[/b] that take advantage of the new resources
[*] Trade routes can be created from individual structures that generate resources to [b]hubs that manage the exchange of value[/b]
[*] With this new logic the player will be able to decide what to invest to generate [b]Hexin[/b], [b]Favor[/b] or [b]Challenge Points[/b] [i](you will know how to spend them with version 1.0.0)[/i]
[*] Previous “Tile upgrades” have been updated and revised in the new [b]building system[/b]; the structures are now more evident and integrate with the new system of trade routes
[*] [b]8 unique structures have been introduced[/b] and with strategic effects connected to the new gameplay logic
[*] Each structure can be [b]placed in any buildable tile[/b], taking advantage of (or undergoing) the effects of the latter
[*] Structures that [b]generate resources[/b] or that [b]apply effects[/b] must be activated through the use of [b]workers[/b]
[*] Structures that use workers can be [b]deactivated[/b] to recover the latter and use them on other structures
[*] Some buildings apply [b]effects to the tiles they are built on[/b]
[*] Buildings can be [b]removed at the cost of AP[/b]
[*] Just as for the tiles, the structures will also have their own contextual [b]infobox[/b] in which all the necessary information can be consulted
[*] Added the system of [b]Bonus / Malus[/b] that can last for the whole game or only for a certain number of rounds
[*] The [b]official story[/b], divided into chapters, has finally been implemented
[*] Each chapter of the story can be read again with the "[b]Story Log[/b]" feature
[*] The [b]Events[/b] have been adjusted to the new gameplay
[*] Each event will generate a [b]bonus[/b] or [b]malus[/b] depending on the choice made
[*] Events [b]may be ignored[/b], causing a penalty. You will have to choose, during the game, if this penalty is better than receiving a potentially greater one
[*] The [b]missions of each chapter[/b] have been totally revised and optimized, with a much more detailed UI
[*] Added three new languages: [b]Spanish[/b], [b]French[/b] and [b]German[/b]. [u][i]We are aware that the localization is not yet 100% perfect, we are finishing the final control and adjustment phase[/i][/u].
[/list]

Have fun everyone from Davide and Giacomo of Black Mastiff Studio!

notes.title: Modified release date and new update
notes.notes:
We are back from [b]GDC[/b] in San Francisco and would like to report that Hexia will undergo a change in its final release date. The reasons are very simple: at GDC we interacted with important contacts, who evaluated the new version and provided us with a lot of useful information to take Hexia to the heights of quality it really deserves to reach.

In any case, an updated version of Hexia will be released on the [b]31st[/b]: [b]0.9.0[/b] to be precise, which will begin to show what will then be further strengthened and improved.
This will also be useful for us to receive valuable feedback and to be able to better prepare for the release with more languages, more details and higher quality.

Our Studio is evolving and these are crucial steps to allow the game to show its full potential, which would otherwise be wasted in a too hasty release.
See you on [b]March 31[/b] with the last update of this early access, before the actual debut of the title.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0 release date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243517/a352a1f1d0a6bb0690a55749fd7e45a76aa3ef7d.png[/img]

Finally we are in March!
Black Mastiff Studio is pleased to announce that we will release Hexia [b]version 1.0.0[/b] on the [b]31st of this month[/b].

And that's not all! For those who are curious to see or try out the new upcoming version, they can visit us in the Italian Booth directly at [b]GDC 2023[/b] in San Francisco!
We will give you more information on this subject in a few days.

notes.title: Version 0.5.5
notes.notes:
Summer holidays are now over and we are back to work on Hexia!
We close the month of August with a small update that mainly concerns the Engine.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Project updated to Unreal Engine 4.27
[*] Minor changes to the UI
[*] Minor updates to the game core
[/list]

With September we will be back with new updates, stay tuned!

notes.title: Version 0.5.4
notes.notes:
The summer goes on and so does the work on Hexia!
The current update may seem "small" but, in reality, it sets the stage for something much more substantial. Don't worry, we will soon be giving more information about it.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Revised the [b]pause system[/b], fixing some bugs on tile upgrades
[*] New [b]save system[/b] that corrects problems reported in our community
[*] Added a [b]little cinematic[/b] - this is a preview of what we're going to create in our Hexia core
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

That's it for now, we'll be back soon with lots of news on the future of Hexia and more in-depth details on development.
We also thank all those who are supporting us with live on Twitch and videos on YouTube, for us it is essential and we are writing down everything you report and think about on Hexia!

notes.title: Our first big update
notes.notes:
We are working hard to release our very [b]first big update[/b]. Precisely for this reason no new builds were released last week, nor this week (Demo aside). We want Hexia to take its first step forward, getting closer to a solid structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243517/220fcb47005ac0cb09676220e70f2ebc274a19f9.png[/img]

What you will see coming out will include the start of the [b]campaign system[/b], a [b]more comfortable interface[/b], core updates and other improvements that you will surely notice as you play.

We continue to follow your feedback and our roadmap, to transform the world of Hexia into something concrete. We apologize for the wait but we are sure that the result will be appreciated!

Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.7
notes.notes:
We have finally published our Roadmap for Hexia, you will find it at the bottom of this news too. This week's update is about some changes in preparation for the Hexia Demo. Yes, you got it right: we will release a Demo version that will allow those who do not want to buy Early Access to try Hexia anyway, with some limitations.

[h3]Path Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Completely changed the initial screen
[*]Added the "clouds" effect under the tiles
[*]Updated and improved event window 
[*]Updated the code with the Demo features that we will release shortly
[/list]

Here is the Hexia Roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243517/ef0de8d6e60ce5c72ef543095a86629ba6fea6b1.png[/img]

Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.6
notes.notes:
This week we focused on some fixes that solve some annoying problems and we have improved usability on two small elements.

[h3]Path Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Now you will no longer go into Game Over instantly, the check will only take place at the beginning of the new day and after calculating your earnings. If, despite the earnings, you are still at a Population value of zero then the Game Over will be triggered. 
[*]Fix on the Population gain indicator, in the Top Bar. This did not correctly display the malus applied when going negative with the Hexins 
[*]With each new notification, the icon now changes color 
[*]Each time a Kingdom Upgrades is unlocked, the UI icon will change color 
[/list]

See you at the next update, as always [b]next week[/b].

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.5
notes.notes:
Today Hexia celebrates its [b]first month of Early Access[/b], cheers! We are taking small steps towards a more stable game structure.

[h3]Path Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed excessive consumption of GPU and CPU
[*]First revision of the UI, with new icons and space optimization
[*]Selecting a Tile, or discovering a new one, will no longer automatically shift the view
[*]Fixed a bug on Tooltips: they will now no longer overlap each other
[*]Credits screen added
[*]Unreal Engine updated to version 4.26
[/list]

See you at the next update, as always [b]next week[/b].

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.4
notes.notes:
Here we are with a new update, lighter than the previous one but which allows us to correct some things reported by the players.

[h3]Path Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in Kingdom Upgrades that did not consider the Unique of an Upgrade when loading a previous game
[*]Fixed the "Market district" Upgrade which also counted the Castle in the applied bonus
[*]Even the small notifications in the Top Bar are sorted from newest to oldest
[*]Tile Tooltips now better show upgrade informations
[/list]

See you at the next update, as always [b]next week[/b].

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.3
notes.notes:
Here we are with the [b]Alpha Version 0.0.3[/b], in this update we have focused on some aspects of UI and management. 

[h3]Path Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed bug that opens VR application on Hexia startup
[*]The notification list is now displayed from newest to oldest
[*]By clicking on “Tile Upgrade” the camera will focus on the currently selected Tile
[*]Added the “Kingdom Management” screen that can be viewed from the new button in the top bar. The window is still in the prototype phase.
[*]Now the game starts with 15 Population and no longer 10
[*]UI: Minor tweaks and improvements
[*]The “Kingdom Management” window can be moved
[/list]

Remember that for any feedback you can find us on [b]Discord[/b], a very useful social channel for us. You can also use the Steam community or our social networks.

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.0.2
notes.notes:
Here we go, our first Hexia update is live.
We will continue to update Hexia [b]every week[/b], in order to advance with the implementation of the planned features.

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix labels stating "minutes" instead of "days"
[*] When the Kingdom Upgrades screen is open, scrolling the window no longer interferes with Map Zoom
[*] Added a Game Over prototype screen
[*] If the population reaches 0, it will be Game Over
[*] Every day that the player is in negative of Hexin he will lose 10 of population
[*] Created a core system that randomly alternates music during a game
[/list]

That's all for now, we take the opportunity to [b]thank all[/b] those who are trying Hexia and giving us their opinions: thank you very much for believing in our work!
For everyone else who is still undecided, we will work hard to create something you can enjoy, we promise.
